resources.string: Connect your phone to the PC, choose a mode, then start. View the full camera image on the PC.
Use the same network or USB tethering. Confirm pairing on the PC.
Looking for a PC. You can also enter its address manually.
Could not find a PC. Check the network or enter its address.
Found %1$s (%2$s). Confirm this phone on the PC.
PC address changed. Stop the current stream to reconnect.
120 FPS and higher where supported. Hardware H.264, full frame. PC inference speed is independent of capture FPS.
Standard camera capture with software JPEG. Crop before compression and adjust quality to reduce bandwidth and latency.
Lower Q reduces data size; higher Q preserves detail. Default Q80. No hardware JPEG encoding.

Remove 0–45% per edge, relative to the rotated view. Only the retained area is copied and compressed; no resizing. Rounded to even pixels for YUV. Keep PC rotation on Auto. Stop streaming to change settings; recalibrate after changing crop or rotation.
Enter a crop percentage from 0 to 45 for each edge.
Resolutions: %1$d · Frame rates: %2$d. Choose either first; the other adjusts only if needed. Resolution is the capture size before optional Camera-mode cropping.
Frame rate adjusted to %1$d FPS to support the selected resolution.
Resolution adjusted to %1$s to support the selected frame rate.
This camera has no compatible high-speed / H.264 combination. Choose another camera or Camera mode.
No usable combination for this camera. Choose another camera or refresh.
No cameras found. Grant camera permission and refresh.
Ready. Start when the PC receiver is open.
Enter a PC address or use Find PC.
Camera permission is required. Grant it in system settings, then retry.
Could not read camera capabilities. Close other camera apps and refresh.
This combination could not start and has been excluded for now. Select another one or refresh to retry.
Connection stopped. Check the PC receiver, address and network, then start again.
Camera stopped. Close other camera apps and try again.
Camera geometry could not be sent. Try another camera or reconnect to the PC.

Live phone-side metrics. High-speed output counts encoded frames; Camera mode counts frames delivered to the app. Capture-to-encode timing requires a compatible sensor clock and excludes network, PC processing and display delay. See PC Performance for the full pipeline.
Keep this app in the foreground while streaming.
